scope: old 13 scenes only; no new-development or confirmation arrays
statistical_unit: scene; per-frame quantiles reported descriptively and never as independent samples

geometry.method: calibrated ray intersection with per-object fit-scene median body-height prior
geometry.oracle_observation: GT projected body origin UV; no heldout depth or height fed to solver
geometry.natural_auxiliary: existing old-scene OOF localized UV head, three-seed ensemble; learned depth excluded from plane solver
geometry.stop: Do not claim universal 3D recovery from a single center; no new training unless mechanism isolated and nontrivial legal geometry supports all required states

p4: requires separate frozen protocol after evidence-based GO; no automatic search
